basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace blueprint and pilot plan for small and mid-size contractors, tested with contractors and regional distributors.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Should MetalCo go ahead with a pilot of the marketplace in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Test the marketplace with a small contractor group in one region and measure repeat orders and distributor reaction.

gate.label: Scale-up decision
gate.decision: Do the pilot results justify extending the marketplace beyond the pilot region?

workstreams.name: Scope and hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions about the marketplace must be tested, and for which blueprint components?
activities: Review the existing B2B ordering portal and its users
Draft hypotheses for each blueprint component
Agree scope with the CEO and Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Contractor demand evidence
workstreams.answers: What do small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain need in order to buy online?
activities: Interview small and mid-size contractors on how they order
Analyze order data from the existing B2B ordering portal
Test a wireframe prototype with contractors

deliverables.name: Contractor evidence on the marketplace hypotheses

workstreams.name: Distributor impact
workstreams.answers: How would a direct online channel affect the regional distributors and their contracts?
activities: Interview regional distributors about contractor sales
Analyze sales by channel across the 14 warehouses
Review distributor contract terms

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What does the tested marketplace blueprint look like and what does the pilot in one region need?
activities: Consolidate tested hypotheses into the blueprint
Detail the pilot plan for one region
Prepare the pilot go/no-go pack for the steering group

deliverables.name: Detailed pilot plan for the go/no-go decision

workstreams.name: Pilot enablement
workstreams.answers: Which targets, roles and stakeholder agreements does the pilot need before and while it runs?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO and Head of Sales
Align the regional distributors council on pilot rules
Identify the roles to hire or assign for the pilot

deliverables.name: Pilot KPIs agreed with key stakeholders
Key internal hires identified for the pilot

workstreams.name: Pilot target group
workstreams.answers: Which contractors in the pilot region should be the first to use the marketplace?
activities: Interview contractors in the pilot region on ordering needs
Segment contractors in the pilot region from sales records

deliverables.name: First contractor target group for the pilot

workstreams.name: Marketplace first version
workstreams.answers: Does a first marketplace version work for contractors in the pilot region?
activities: Build the first marketplace version for the pilot region
Launch it to a small group of contractors and support them
Review fit with the existing B2B ordering portal

deliverables.name: First version launched to small contractor group

workstreams.name: Pilot results and scale-up
workstreams.answers: What did the pilot show on repeat orders and distributor contracts, and what would a scale-up need?
activities: Track repeat orders from contractors in the pilot region
Check distributor contract status in the pilot region
Build the business case and implementation plan

deliverables.name: Pilot results against the success criteria
Business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, goals and ways of working
events.decision: Is the steering group aligned on scope, success criteria and ways of working?
agenda: Present the engagement scope and plan of work
Align on success criteria and steering group roles
Confirm access to the people and data the team needs

events.label: Check-in: early evidence
events.purpose: Review early evidence and adjust direction
events.decision: Does the early evidence support the focus of the blueprint work?
agenda: Present the hypotheses and early contractor evidence
Discuss open questions on the hypotheses
Confirm the focus for the blueprint and pilot plan

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether to proceed to the pilot
events.decision: Should MetalCo go ahead with a pilot of the marketplace in one region?
agenda: Present the blueprint, evidence and distributor impact
Review the wireframe prototype and the pilot plan
Decide on the go/no-go for a pilot in one region

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot launch
events.purpose: Review pilot setup and first launch
events.decision: Is the pilot set up to run against the agreed KPIs?
agenda: Present the KPIs, target group and launched first version
Review the roles needed and distributor engagement in the pilot
Align on adjustments before the results weeks

events.label: Scale-up decision
events.purpose: Decide on the step after the pilot
events.decision: Do the pilot results justify extending the marketplace beyond the pilot region?
agenda: Present pilot results against both success criteria
Review the business case, implementation plan and roadmap
Decide on extending the marketplace beyond the pilot region

architect_notes: The brief gives 20 weeks in total and no stage lengths; the 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split is an estimate.
The marketplace is new, so the plan stops at the pilot; rollout after the pilot is not in these phases.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, Construction Products Regulation digital product passports. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Added to the archetype: Distributor impact in Design and a pilot results analysis, because the brief names distributors and repeat orders as success criteria.
The archetype calls for two Pilot workshops; at 14 weeks the rules allow one, so Pilot has a single workshop.
